g.text: G.O.K.U · Office Fetch Robot · Git Quick Reference

svg.text: always runnable · merge via PR · 1 reviewer required
Stand-up: (1) done last week (2) doing this week (3) blockers
Before supervisor: prepare agenda · bring specific questions · record action items
Don't just make the code work — treat the process as a well-managed engineering project.
Supervisors evaluate methodology, decision-making, and collaboration — not just results.
